record.issue_text: Crash on undefined destinationCalendar in EventManager: the Meet fallback destructures evt.destinationCalendar but accesses mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without optional chaining, throwing TypeError when destinationCalendar is [] or element is undefined

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the Meet fallback now does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then immediately accesses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without null/undefined guarding. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `undefined`, `null`, or `[]` (which several call sites in this diff now set, e.g. `destinationCalendar: []`), `mainHostDestinationCalendar` will be `undefined` and `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` will throw a `TypeError` at runtime.
